question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH product_events AS (
    SELECT 
        ph.product_id,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 1 THEN 1 END) as views,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN e.event_type = 2 THEN 1 END) as add_to_cart
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    WHERE ph.product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND e.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    GROUP BY ph.product_id
),
purchase_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id FROM shopping_cart_events 
    WHERE page_id = 13 AND event_type = 3
),
purchase_products AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.visit_id, ph.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON e.page_id = ph.page_id
    JOIN purchase_visits pv ON e.visit_id = pv.visit_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 2 AND ph.product_id IS NOT NULL
),
product_purchases AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as purchases
    FROM purchase_products
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT 
    pe.product_id,
    pe.views,
    pe.add_to_cart,
    pe.add_to_cart - COALESCE(pp.purchases, 0) as left_in_cart,
    COALESCE(pp.purchases, 0) as purchases
FROM product_events pe
LEFT JOIN product_purchases pp ON pe.product_id = pp.product_id
ORDER BY pe.product_id
